title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs quickstarts
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: provide first-class RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates and tool-calling examples that map to the new docs quickstarts and examples gallery. This PR bundles: 1) three opinionated RAG agent templates (qa, summarization, and agent-assistant) for Python and TypeScript, 2) two tool-calling examples (calendar and search) that demonstrate secure tool invocation and structured output, and 3) docs site updates (quickstarts, sidebar nav, and a new 'Agents & RAG' section).

Changes include: - examples/rag/* (playbooks and runnable samples) - docs/quickstarts/rag-quickstart.md - docs/agents/agent-templates.md - docs/reference/tool-calling.md - site/sidebar.json and docs metadata updates - updated example Dockerfiles and CI docs-site workflow to include the new pages

Checklist: - [x] Add Python + TS agent templates - [x] Add tool-calling examples with safe stubs - [x] Docs quickstart and step-by-step guide - [x] Update sidebar and search index - [x] CI builds and local preview passing - [x] Add integration tests for examples (lightweight smoke tests)

Usage notes: The examples are runnable locally (see examples/README.md). Tool-calling examples include mocked tool servers under examples/tools/ with instructions to swap in real services. The RAG templates include recommended retrieval configs and a sample eval prompt set for quality monitoring.

Related: ENG-4721 (agent templates initiative), DOC-891 (docs quickstart epic). Will follow up with a second PR to add additional language bindings and an official SDK snippet in the 'Getting started' page.
